published_as: Local APK for owner verification; coordinator publishes the Release
changes: Fixed inSampleSize: decoded images never exceed the requested width (the old >= comparison left heroes at 1080 px when 720 was requested).
Capped every bundled-image decode to 720 px and reduced the LRU cache from 48 MB to 24 MB.
Removed two defensive !! operators in RosaryScreen and added AssetDecodeBudgetTest plus a 55-chaplet guide audit.
tests: 14/14 on Rosary, chaplet guides, image budget and crash recorder
known_limitations: Owner must confirm on a physical phone; no error report from the 1.9.2 crash was available.
